packageRules.description: Dev-only and CI updates merge themselves. platformAutomerge hands the merge to GitHub so it goes through branch protection natively rather than a bot pushing past it.
Runtime dependencies ship to consumers, so they stay manual: each one needs a changeset and a look at what actually changed.
chalk 6 requires Node >=22, but @mocktomata/cli supports Node >=20. Lift when the engines floor is raised.
Majors are always a human call, whatever the depType.
